title: Restormel route graph export bundle
description: Portable snapshot of one route and its steps for GitOps and agent diffs. No secrets. Additional properties allowed on route/steps objects for forward compatibility.

exportedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the bundle was produced.

route.description: Route row (control plane); keys align with dashboard RouteRecord JSON.

items.description: Route step row; rich policies optional per route-step-rich.schema.json.
